- Billing: Outreach will bill Redwood Inference, Inc. in USD. I'll send wire instructions in a separate secure email.
- Payment terms: Outreach can accept Net 45 for this agreement; I'll note that in the invoice section.

- Security addendum: Outreach can sign a Redwood security addendum that references SOC 2 controls and data separation; legal has the template.
- HubSpot/SCIM/4 admin seats: Confirmed — will add field-mapping appendix and include 4 admin training seats in week 1.

I've updated the SOW per the notes and started a DocuSign envelope. Link: https://www.docusign.com/Redwood/Envelope/ABC123

If you can confirm final signatories (name, title, email) I will route the envelope for signature and we can schedule the onboarding kickoff for the week of Feb 14.

Best,
